workflow.name: Phase 8P R3 expanded prediction family synthetic gate (retry 2)

assertions: target endpoints cannot precede decision sessions
training labels must mature strictly before the OOF validation boundary
training samples obey the frozen purge
initial OOF validation embargo sessions are excluded
OOF validation target endpoints must remain inside the same validation fold
probability adapter accepts either positive-class vector or two-column probability matrix and validates shape

prior_failed_run.root_cause: OOF helper indexed a one-dimensional positive-class probability vector as a two-column matrix
prior_failed_run.disposition: preserved as non-accepting history; corrected in tested source commit

limitations: This is a synthetic code-contract gate only, not empirical prediction evidence.
The full R3 eligibility/executor gates remain unresolved; no model is authorized for market-data fitting.
